title: zkLend — Precision Loss / Share Inflation Attack on Starknet Money Market
root_cause: Precision loss in `safe_decimal_math::div()`: an attacker uses flash loans to inflate the `lending_accumulator` to `~4.069×10^45`, then exploits integer truncation so that withdrawing 1.5× the deposited amount still burns only 1 zToken — netting free wstETH on each cycle
steps: Example step: accumulator 1e27 → 702e27 (702× amplification in one tx)
→ Receive 6.103e18 wstETH while burning only 1 zToken
[5] Repeat step [4] ~61 times → total wstETH stolen ≈ 61 wstETH (~$9.5M)
